title: Gate VCF Operations log-forwarder creation on a collision precheck
prompt:
Complete `VcfOpsLogForwarder/VcfOpsLogForwarder.psm1` as a PowerShell 7.4 module that safely creates a VCF Operations Log Management forwarder only when its name is absent.

Before implementing, research the VCF Operations Log Management operations `getAllLogForwarders` and `createLogForwarder` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer. Use those operations in that order and contact no other route.

VCF PowerCLI 9.1 supplies `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops` version `13.5.0.25380678`. Keep that prerequisite in the module manifest. Do not install, download, copy, generate, vendor, redefine, replace, or imitate VMware modules or SDK assemblies. This module is a focused Log Management REST extension to an authenticated VMware.Sdk.Vcf Operations workflow: the caller supplies the Log Management origin and the `X-JWT-Token` obtained for service key `ops-li`. Use `System.Net.Http.HttpClient`; do not use `Invoke-RestMethod`, `Invoke-WebRequest`, curl, a subprocess, or raw sockets.

Preserve and export only:

`New-VcfOpsLogForwarderIfAbsent -BaseUri <uri> -LogToken <string> -Name <string> -Host <string> -Port <1..65535> -Protocol <SYSLOG|RAW|RAWPLUS> -SslEnabled <bool> -TransportProtocol <TCP|UDP> -Enabled <bool> [-HttpClient <System.Net.Http.HttpClient>]`

Parameter binding and validation must perform no traffic. `BaseUri` must be an absolute HTTP(S) origin with no credentials, query, fragment, or non-root path. Reject a blank or surrounding-whitespace name or host, a token that is blank or contains CR/LF, an out-of-range port, and non-enum protocol values before traffic. When `HttpClient` is omitted, create one that does not follow redirects and dispose only the client and handler the function owns. A supplied client is caller-owned.

The wire workflow is exact:

1. Invoke `getAllLogForwarders` once as a bodyless `GET /api/v2/logs/forwarders` with no query. Send exactly one `Accept: application/json` and one `X-JWT-Token`; do not send `Content-Type`. Require HTTP 200 and a JSON array. If any item has a string `name` equal to `Name` by ordinal comparison, the precheck fails with an `InvalidOperationException`. Stop immediately: do not invoke the create operation, do not retry, and change nothing.
2. Only after the precheck proves the name absent, invoke `createLogForwarder` once as `POST /api/v2/logs/forwarders` with no query. Send exactly one `Accept: application/json`, one `X-JWT-Token`, and `Content-Type: application/json`. Its compact UTF-8 JSON body has properties exactly, in this order: `enabled`, `host`, `name`, `port`, `protocol`, `sslEnabled`, and `transportProtocol`. Preserve explicit false values. Every unset `LogForwarder` property — `certificate`, `connectionRefreshInterval`, `constraints`, `forwardComplementaryFields`, read-only `id`, `tags`, and `workerCount` — must be omitted completely, not sent as null, empty, or a default.

Require HTTP 201. Validate the response as a JSON object with a nonblank string `id`, and require all seven echoed request properties to match by type and value. Return one buffered object with properties exactly, in order, `Created`, `OperationId`, and `Id`, whose values are `$true`, `createLogForwarder`, and the returned ID. Write no progress or diagnostic objects to the success pipeline. Any other status, malformed response, or transport failure terminates immediately with a credential-safe error. Never expose the log token or a raw response body in any output or error. There are no redirects or retries.

Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`. Do not modify anything under `tests/` or `docs/`, or `VcfOpsLogForwarder/VcfOpsLogForwarder.psd1`; edit only `VcfOpsLogForwarder/VcfOpsLogForwarder.psm1`.
scenario: a name-collision precheck blocks log-forwarder creation while an absent name permits one exact contract-shaped create request
constraint: the contract-pinned loopback request log proves that a failed precheck causes zero mutating requests and that all unset optional LogForwarder fields are omitted on the wire
